book.name: Aposɨl
book.title: Aposɨl Bɨ Jisas manö ud arep gau kale nan nɨhön nɨhön gɨla

content: Ana Uɫ nɨpe aua
Nɨbi bɨ Jisas nɨp nɨŋ udla gau, Pedikos ñɨn kub u mɨñi, a göm, ap ram raul mɨgan añɨ ap mɨdeila.
Anɨg göl mɨdlö nɨŋöl gɨ, adɨŋ gu kub kumi kabö adö laŋ nɨbö hagöm, yɨgön rö udöm, ram raul mɨgan asɨk mɨdeila au yaŋ aua.
Pen magö anɨbu nöp nɨŋla, mab mɨɫaŋ ugan rö u apöm, pɨlajɨk ke ke pa gɨ dö gɨ amöm, nɨbi bɨ nabɨc cög adö laŋ añɨ añɨ am mɨdeia.
Am mɨdö nɨŋöl gɨ, Ana Uɫ apöm, ana kalɨp aŋ daŋ ajmaŋ raua nɨŋöm kale manö yabɨƚ adö ke ke hagla.
Pen ñɨn anɨbu, Juda nɨbi bɨ gau, kale mɨgan ke ke, ram mɨnöŋ gau nɨbö gau nɨbö apöm, Jerusalem magum gɨ mɨdeila. Nɨbi bɨ anɨb gau kale God Manö haga rö nɨŋöm gɨmɨdal.
Gu kub anɨbu hageia nɨŋöm, nɨhön gab a göm, nɨbi bɨ iru nöp yɨŋɨd ram anɨbu apöm nɨŋla, manö yabɨƚ adö ke ke kabö göl nöp hageila.
Kale nɨŋöm, aiö waiö göm hagla, “Nɨbi bɨ gai i magöŋhalö Galili nɨbö.
Pen aige göm manö yabɨƚ hon ke ke hagpun rö kabö göl hagaböl nɨŋabun?
Hon rɨmnap Padia nɨbö, rɨmnap Midia nɨbö, rɨmnap Ilam nɨbö, rɨmnap Mesopodemia nɨbö, rɨmnap Judia nɨbö, rɨmnap Kapasodia nɨbö, rɨmnap Podas nɨbö, rɨmnap Esia nɨbö,
rɨmnap Prijia nɨbö, rɨmnap Pampilia nɨbö, rɨmnap Ijip nɨbö, rɨmnap ram mɨnöŋ Libia, Sairini daun goƚ gau nɨbö, rɨmnap Rom nɨbö auno.

Nɨbi bɨ Rom nɨbö aula u, rɨmnap Juda nɨbi bɨ yɨjɨg göl, rɨmnap Juda nɨbi bɨ wasö pen uri Juda nɨbi bɨ gɨpal rö adö u gɨpal. Rɨmnap Krir nɨbö, rɨmnap Arebia nɨbö auno. Pen hon nɨŋ mɨdno nɨŋöl gɨ, manö yabɨƚ hon ke ke hagpun rö kabö göl hagöm, God nɨpe nan unbö ke yabɨƚ göp, a göm, hib nɨpe haglö adö arab, nɨŋabun,” a gɨla.
Anɨg hagöm, gasɨ iru nɨŋöl gɨ, pen hag nɨŋö, pen hag nɨŋö göm hagla, “Ke yabɨƚ gab anɨbu nɨhön gɨnɨg gab,” a göm, gasɨ iru yabɨƚ nɨŋla.
Nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap pen kale ñɨñɨƚoŋ lɨ hagla, “U ñɨg wain iru nöp ñɨŋöm, hauƚ alöp hagaböl,” a gɨla.
Pida manö hag ña

Pen Pida bɨ Jisas manö ud arep bɨ unbö agɨp laŋ aip uraköm, meg mɨgan dap ranöm, nɨbi bɨ iru nöp mɨdeila gau kalɨp haga, “Kale Juda nɨbi bɨ hon abe, kale nɨbi bɨ Jerusalem aui hanmɨdim abe, aui nɨhön gajɨp u yad kalöp manö hagnɨg gabin i nɨŋ aij gɨmim.
Kale rɨmnap hagpim, ‘Bɨ gai i ñɨg wain iru nöp ñɨŋöm, hauƚ alöp hagaböl,’ a gɨpim u, pen kale ñɨg wain ñɨŋlö hauƚ alagöp. Mɨñi sɨdö gɨsön nöp auöp magö u nöp me.
Pen manö yabɨƚ ke ke hagaböl nɨŋabim anɨbi, bɨ God manö hagep Joel hadame nöp hagöm kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka rö nöp gab me u. Nɨpe manö anɨbu kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm haga,

content.text: ‘God hagöp, “Ñɨn hain u,
nɨbi bɨ magöŋhalö gau kalɨp Ana yad yunabin.
Ñɨ pai kale gau God Manö nɨbi bɨ kalɨp hag ñɨnaböl.
Bɨ praj kale gau naböŋ nɨŋnaböl.
Bɨ majö kale gau hon nɨŋnaböl.
Ñɨn anɨbu, nɨbi bɨ yɨp wög gɨ ñɨbal gau, nɨbi gau abe bɨ gau abe,
kalɨp Ana yad yunö, manö aij yad u nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp hag ñɨnaböl.
Pen kumi kabö adö laŋ nan ke gagep rö rɨmnap gem,
mɨnöŋ naböŋ adö iƚ i nan nɨŋeb nɨŋagep ke nɨbö rɨmnap gɨnabin.
Hagape göm, mab inöm, hadu adpɨƚ kub göm gɨnab.
Sɨdö mailö gagnab;
rakɨn hagape bö lɨnab.
Anɨg geinab, hainö ñɨn unbö ke nɨbö waiö lɨnab.
Bɨ Kub mailö aij unbö ke halö aunab.
Pen nɨbi bɨ an an, Bɨ Kub yɨp ud kamɨŋ yuaŋ, a göm, hag nɨŋnaböl gau,
kalɨp ud kamɨŋ yunab,” a ga.

content: Pida nɨpe Joel kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka manö anɨbu hag pɨs göm haga, “Kale Isrel nɨbi bɨ, manö hagnɨg gabin i nɨŋ aij gɨmim. Jisas bɨ Nasared nɨbö u bɨ yɨharɨŋ wasö; God nɨpe ke nɨp yuö aua. Ñɨ yad u yunö, nan gagep rö iru nöp göm, nan nɨŋeb nɨŋagep iru nöp göm gɨnab aŋ kalɨp au nɨŋöm, bɨ anɨbu God nɨpe ke hag yuö aua u nɨŋlaŋ, a göm, nɨp yuö aua. Jisas nɨpe nan gagep rö aŋ kale ga u, kale ke hadö nɨŋbim.
God kale gɨnabim rö nöd nɨŋöm, Jisas nɨp ud ñɨmagö adö kalöp u lö, kale dam nɨbi bɨ nan si nan naij gɨpal gau kalɨp ñɨbe, nɨp mab ba laŋ al pak lɨlö uma.
Nɨpe ilön kub yabɨƚ udöm uma u pen böŋ nöp wip rɨgöl au mɨdöm, hij gɨ lug lɨ arnɨm rö laga. God gö kauyaŋ uraka.
Depid pen hadame nöp Jisas nɨp manö kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm haga,

content.text: ‘Yad nɨŋbin, Bɨ Kub yad aip pör pör mɨdöp.
Nɨpe ñɨmagö yɨjɨg yad lau adö mɨdöp u me, yad pɨñɨŋ gagnabin.
Anɨg göp u, hibur mɨdmagö yad pɨƚaiöp; yad ñɨñɨ lem hagabin.
Hañ romaŋ yad umnɨg gab pen gasɨ halö mɨdem pɨñɨŋ gagnabin.
Ai gɨnɨg? Ne yɨp wip rɨgöl mɨgan arö gagnabön.
Ne Bɨ Uɫ ne arö gö, hañ romaŋ nɨpe hij gɨ lug lɨ aragnab.
Ne yɨp kamɨŋ mɨdep adan u yamna.
Yad ne aip mɨdem, mɨñ mɨñ yabɨƚ gɨnabin,’ a ga,” a ga.

content: Pida Depid haga manö anɨbu hag pɨs göm haga, “Añ mam bɨ, yad kalöp manö kabö göl hagnö, nɨŋ aij gɨnabim. Bac iƚaŋ Depid umö rɨgöl gɨla uƚöm mɨgan u mɨdöp; uƚöm mɨgan anɨbu mɨñi hon u rö nöp nɨŋbun.
Pen Depid nɨpe God manö hag ñeb bɨ mɨdmɨdöp u me, nɨpe nɨŋa, God hadame nöp manö hag löm haga, ‘Ne ñɨ rɨknabön rɨk damöm rɨk lɨnaböl ñɨ ap nɨpe ka ne udöm, kiŋ mɨdeinab,’ a ga.
Depid nan hainö gɨnab u nɨŋöm, Mesaia u
nɨpe umöm uraknab, a göm, haga, ‘Nɨp wip rɨgöl mɨgan arö gaga. Hañ romaŋ nɨpe hij gɨ lug lɨ araga,’ a ga.
“Mɨñi God gö, Jisas nɨpe uraköm kamɨŋ mɨdöp. Nɨpe kamɨŋ mɨdöp u hon magöŋhalö amgö magö hon ke nɨŋbun.
God Jisas nɨp dam ñɨmagö yɨjɨg adö nɨpe lau la. Löm nɨpe Ana Uɫ ñɨnabin a göm haga u, Jisas nɨp ñö, nɨpe pen hanɨp ñö, apöm gu kub hagö, hon manö ke ke hagabun i nɨŋabim.
Pen Depid manö haga anɨbu, nɨpe ke hagaga. Depid nɨpe mɨnöŋ naböŋ iƚ i mɨdöm, kumi kabö adö laŋ araga. Pen nɨpe haga,

content.text: ‘Bɨ Kub nɨpe Bɨ Kub yad u nɨp haga,
“Ñɨmagö yɨjɨg yad lau adö asɨk mɨdaimön me;
yad gɨnö kauaƚ mauaƚ ne gau,
raƚa mɨgan ne gau mɨdeinaböl,” a ga,’ a ga.

content: “Anɨb u, kale Isrel nɨbi bɨ magöŋhalö nɨŋ aij gɨmim: Jisas bɨ mab ba laŋ al pak lɨbe uma bɨ anɨbu nöp, God gö Bɨ Kub yabɨƚ mɨdöp. Nɨpe nöp Mesaia pör abad mɨdmɨdun me u,” a ga.
Pida manö anɨbu hagö, nɨbi bɨ mɨdeila gau nɨŋöm ñaul ara. Anɨg gö, kale Pida abe, Jisas manö ud arep bɨ gau abe, hag nɨŋöm hagla, “Anɨb u, mam bɨ, hon mɨñi nɨhön gun?” ö gɨla.

Hageila, Pida haga, “Kale añɨ añɨ magöŋhalö mɨdpim rö, nan si nan naij gɨpim adö u, nɨhön gɨnɨg anɨg gɨpun, a gɨmim, arö gɨmim, Jisas Krais nɨp nɨŋ udmim, ñɨg pakmim. Anɨg geinabim, God nan si nan naij gɨpim u nɨŋöm arö göm, Ana Uɫ nɨpe u kalöp ñɨnab.

God hadame nöp haga, ‘Ana yad kalöp Isrel nɨbi bɨ ñem, ñɨ pai kale yag daunabim gau kalɨp ñem, nɨbi bɨ mɨlö gau kalɨp abe ñem gɨnabin,’ a ga. Anɨb u, hon nɨŋbun, God nɨbi bɨ an an aulaŋ a gɨnab gau, kalɨp magöŋhalö Ana Uɫ u ñɨnab,” a ga.
Pida kalɨp mög nɨŋöm, manö iru nöp hagöm hagöm haga, “Nɨbi bɨ uri mɨdpal rɨmnap haƚöwaƚö gɨ naij gɨpal rö arö gɨmim, mɨd aij gɨmim. Wasö u, ilön kub udnabim,” a ga.
Nɨbi bɨ iru nöp Pida manö haga u nɨŋöm, Jisas Krais nɨp nɨŋ udöm, ñɨg pakla. Ñɨn anɨbu nöp, nɨbi bɨ dri dausan (3000) rö Jisas Krais nɨp nɨŋ udöm, Jisas nɨbi bɨ nɨpe aip jɨm ñöl mɨdeila.
Anɨb u, kale pör pör apöm, bɨ Jisas manö ud arep bɨ gau aip se göl mɨdöm, God Manö hag ñeila u nɨŋ aij gun, a göm, hag amɨl apɨl göl gɨ, bred ud jö göm se göl ñɨŋöl gɨ, God nɨp sabe göl gɨ mɨdmɨdal.
Jisas nɨbi bɨ nɨpe gau gɨmɨdal rö
God bɨ Jisas manö ud arep bɨ gau kalɨp pɨdöŋ ñö, nan gagep rö iru nöp göm, nan nɨŋeb nɨŋagep iru nöp göm gɨlö, nɨbi bɨ gau nɨŋöm, aiö waiö gɨla.
Nɨbi bɨ Jisas nɨp nɨŋ udla gau, se gɨ mɨdöm, nɨbi bɨ nan mɨdageia gau, nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap kalɨp nan haƚöwaƚö ñɨla.
Mɨnöŋ nabö?, nan gau u rö nöp sɨkim göm, mani udöm, nɨbi bɨ nan mɨdageia gau kalɨp nɨme lɨ ñɨla.
Kale pör pör, ñɨn añɨ añɨ, God sabe gep ram u am magum gɨmɨdal. Pen ram kale gau u rö nöp am magum göm, bred ud jö göm, mɨdmagö apen löl gɨ, ñɨñɨ löl gɨ, nan se göl ñɨŋmɨdal.

Pen nɨbi bɨ mɨdeila gau magöŋhalö, Jisas nɨŋ udla nɨbi bɨ kalɨp nɨŋlö, aij a ga. Pör pör, ñɨn añɨ añɨ, Bɨ Kub nɨpe nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap halö ud kamɨŋ yuö, kale Jisas nɨp nɨŋ udöm, ap Jisas nɨbi bɨ nɨpe nöd nɨbö gau aip mɨdmɨdal.

footnotes.text: Grik manö “Krais u” abe, Hibru manö “Mesaia u” abe iƚ añɨ ap nöp mɨdöp: “God hag la Bɨ u.”
